customers.title: Customers
customers.search: Search by name, phone or email
customers.archiveHint: The customer leaves the list and can be restored from the archived ones.
customers.restoreHint: The customer returns to the list.

form.identityHint: The name and contact details your team relies on.
form.name: Name
form.phoneHint: Enter the number with its country code. Without one it is read as a number from {country}.
form.invalidPhone: The phone number is not valid
form.partyKindNotAllowed: This type is not enabled in the customer settings
form.fieldsHint: The fields your company defined in the customer settings.
form.parentHint: Optional. Pick the company this customer belongs to.
form.parentCompaniesHint: Leave empty to create a company, or pick a company to create a contact under it.
form.parentRefused: The customer cannot be linked to this company

conflict.title: Customers with this number exist
conflict.description: Open one of them, or create a new customer if this is someone else.
conflict.newHint: Create the customer even though the number matches.

settings.readOnly: Customer settings belong to the managers of the main company. You can see them but cannot change them from here.

sharing.title: Customer sharing
sharing.hint: Does each branch see only its own customers, or does the whole establishment share them?
sharing.branchHint: Each customer belongs to the branch that created it and only that branch's staff see it.
sharing.establishmentHint: Every customer is shared between branches, so staff of any branch find them.
sharing.shareTitle: Before choosing "Customers of the whole establishment"
sharing.shareContacts: A shared customer's contacts and bank accounts are visible to staff of any branch who hold the matching capability.
sharing.shareEdit: Anyone who holds "Manage customers" in any branch can edit a shared customer.
sharing.transferRequired: Sharing cannot change once customers exist. Moving customers between the two modes comes in a later release, and the current value stays.

partyKinds.title: Customer types
partyKinds.hint: Decides the form a new customer gets. It does not change existing customers.
partyKinds.individualsHint: Every new customer is an individual and the company option is not offered.
partyKinds.companiesHint: Every new customer is a company. A contact under a company stays possible.
partyKinds.bothHint: Staff choose the customer type when creating.

phoneCountry.title: Default phone country
phoneCountry.hint: The country a number written without a country code is read in.
phoneCountry.help: Pick a country, or the main company's country.

fields.title: Customer fields
fields.hint: Fields your company adds to every customer. A new field appears empty on all customers.

fields.needed: Some removed fields hold values. Confirm the removal below.
fields.title: Remove fields that hold values
fields.hint: Removing a field deletes its values from customers and cannot be undone.
fields.confirm: Remove the fields and their values

options.needed: Some removed options are in use by customers. Confirm the removal below.
options.title: Remove options that customers use
options.hint: Removing an option clears it from the customers who hold it and cannot be undone.

both.needed: Some removed fields hold values and some removed options are in use. Confirm the removal below.
both.title: Remove fields and options in use
both.hint: Removing a field deletes its values, and removing an option clears it from the customers who hold it. This cannot be undone.

removal.optionRow: Option {option} of field {field}: 1 customer | Option {option} of field {field}: {count} customers

privacy.title: Privacy and personal data
privacy.intro: Data subject requests under the personal data protection law: export what we hold about the customer, or erase their personal data. Every action is logged with its reason.
privacy.forbidden: This page is for the system administrator only.
privacy.reasonHint: For example: written request from the customer on a given date. The reason is kept in the privacy log, up to {max} characters.
privacy.reasonRefused: The reason was not accepted. Use plain text of at most {max} characters.

export.title: Export personal data
export.description: An Excel file with everything we hold about this customer and their contacts: details, bank accounts, leads, conversations, invoices and payments. The export is logged.
export.failed: Could not export the file. Try again.

erase.title: Erase personal data
erase.description: Removes the name, contact details and everything that identifies the customer from their records. An erase cannot be undone. Review first what will be erased and what stays.
erase.reviewFailed: Could not load the review. Try again.
erase.valid: This review is valid for {minutes} minutes, then it must be repeated.
erase.willEraseHint: Their personal data is wiped and cannot be recovered.
erase.willKeepHint: These records stay linked to the customer's record with their numbers and amounts, because accounting and regulatory rules require them.
erase.notCoveredHint: These places are outside the erase. Review them by hand if needed.
erase.unhandled: Applications the erase does not support yet
erase.nothing: Nothing is linked to this customer.
erase.blockedHint: The erase will not start until the following is resolved, so no customer data is left behind by accident.

application_has_no_hook.title: An application does not support the erase yet
application_has_no_hook.action: It holds records linked to the customer and the erase does not know how to handle them. Tell the LiwanOS team, or move or delete those records first, then review again.

session_does_not_cover_every_company.title: The session does not cover every branch
session_does_not_cover_every_company.action: This customer is shared by every branch. Switch to a session that covers the main company and all branches, then review again.

caller_cannot_reach_all_records.title: You cannot see every record
caller_cannot_reach_all_records.action: Some records of this kind are outside your access. Ask a manager with wider access to run the erase.

unknown.title: Unknown reason
unknown.action: The erase cannot run now. Tell the LiwanOS team about the entry listed.

confirm.title: Confirm erasing personal data
confirm.description: What is listed above will be erased for good. The customer no longer shows under their name.
confirm.nameLabel: Type the customer's name to confirm
confirm.nameWrong: The name does not match. Type "{name}" exactly as it is.

refused.token: The review expired, so a new one was loaded. Check what it shows and confirm again.
refused.conflict: The customer changed during the review, so a new one was loaded. Check what it shows and confirm again.
refused.forbidden: You do not have the right to erase personal data.
refused.missing: This customer was not found or you cannot see it.
refused.other: The erase failed and nothing changed. Try again.

done.title: The customer's personal data was erased
done.description: The customer now shows as erased and cannot be erased a second time. The request was logged with its reason.

erased.title: This customer is erased
erased.description: Their personal data was erased before, and there is nothing left to erase.

keptWhy.finance_documents: Posted accounting documents must be kept with their numbers and amounts.
keptWhy.finance_entry_lines: Entry lines are part of the accounting books.
keptWhy.finance_payments: Payments are part of the accounting books.
keptWhy.finance_statement_lines: Statement lines are part of the bank reconciliation.
keptWhy.inbox_conversations: The conversation stays without its texts to prove how contact went.
keptWhy.inbox_consent: Proof of the customer's consent or refusal must be kept.
keptWhy.payment_orders: Payment orders feed tax returns and accounting documents.

notCoveredKeys.chatter_history: The history of notes and changes on records
notCoveredKeys.stored_documents: Files and documents stored outside the customer record
notCoveredKeys.accounting_name_copies: The name copied into accounting documents
notCoveredKeys.inbox_provider_events: Messaging provider events kept as received
